verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs say self-hosting runs the complete platform within your own infrastructure with full control over your data. Documented paths include Docker for a full environment and Kubernetes/OpenShift via Helm charts and operators, plus a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs evaluation close to your servers. The source is published on GitHub. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement for the self-hosted distribution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a production self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure

citations.quote: Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your data, security policies, and deployment environment.
This guide explains how to run a full Flagsmith environment on your local machine using Docker.
Kubernetes and OpenShift: Full Kubernetes deployment with Helm charts and operators
The Flagsmith Edge Proxy is a service that you host yourself, that allows you to run an instance of the Flagsmith Engine close to your servers.
